courier-relay/protocol-1-delivery-identi: Courier Relay protocol 1 delivery-identity contract (governs receipt-analysis commands). Source of approval: vendor/protocol-1.md (provider contract); applied to the summary command in issue trial-ky8 (closed 2026-09-07); the accepted command was added under the then-current protocol in issue trial-svg (closed 2026-09-08), and the explicit protocol 1 accepted export requested by the integration partner was delivered and verified in issue trial-noi (closed 2026-09-08), including public suite accepted_1.json (empty set returns zero counts and receipts [], single receipt returned unchanged). Scope: all protocol "1" commands, currently count (original single-account use), summary (cross-account batches), and accepted (receipt-returning; returns exactly {protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count, receipts} with the selected representatives unchanged and in original input order); count and summary return exactly {protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count}. Identity rule: the pair (account_id, delivery_id) identifies a delivery; the same delivery_id under a different account_id is a SEPARATE delivery and both are accepted. Account attribution alone does not change the provider delivery-ID allocation guarantee. Duplicate rule: exactly one receipt accepted per identity, all others duplicates. Winner rule, from vendor/protocol-1.md and exercised by the accepted command: accept the receipt with the earliest occurred_at UTC instant (compare as instants, offsets may cross date boundaries); equal instants use the smallest record_id (Unicode code-point order); accepted receipts retain original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, presented in original input order. Protocol selection: omitted protocol selects the current protocol (currently "2", see courier-relay/protocol-2-delivery-identity); an explicit supported protocol selects that version and remains supported after a new current version is introduced. Public suites run via: python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/<suite>.json.
courier-relay/protocol-2-delivery-identi: Courier Relay protocol 2 delivery-identity contract (governs receipt-analysis commands). Source of approval: provider permanent adoption of protocol 2 plus integration-owner approval to use it as the current protocol (issue trial-ekp, closed 2026-09-08); accepted-command response shape approved in issue trial-svg (closed 2026-09-08). Scope: all protocol "2" commands and omitted-protocol requests, currently count, summary, and accepted; count and summary return exactly {protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count}, shapes unchanged, reporting the actual protocol used. Accepted command: returns exactly {protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count, receipts}; receipts holds the accepted representatives selected under this contract, unchanged and in original input order; overall counts equal summary for the same request (same selection computation); empty set returns receipts [] and both counts zero; a single input receipt is returned unchanged. Identity rule: delivery_id ALONE identifies a delivery across all accounts; the same delivery_id under another account is another receipt of that delivery, not a separate delivery. Duplicate rule: exactly one receipt accepted per delivery identity, all others duplicates. Winner rule (contrast with protocol 1 earliest): accept the receipt with the LATEST occurred_at UTC instant (compare as instants, offsets may cross date boundaries); equal instants use the smallest record_id (Unicode code-point order); accepted receipts retain original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, presented in original input order. The agreement applies to the entire supplied set regardless of receipt dates; empty sets have zero counts; one receipt has one accepted and zero duplicates. Protocol selection: omitted protocol selects the current protocol, which is now "2"; explicit "2" selects this agreement; explicit "1" keeps the protocol 1 contract in courier-relay/protocol-1-delivery-identity (vendor/protocol-1.md), including its earliest-instant winner; explicit supported versions remain supported after a current-version change. Implemented in main.py (CURRENT_PROTOCOL, delivery_identity, accepted_receipts, accepted_details); verified by tests/ (unit and CLI, incl. tests/test_accepted.py) and public suites count_1.json, summary_1.json, summary_2.json, accepted_2.json via python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/<suite>.json.
